factsTableHint: Query and export facts produced by the acquisition source. This workspace is read-only.
collectionFactsEmpty: No source facts match the filters.
collectionFactsOperationFailed: The Fact Table operation did not complete. Check the saved Backend connection and input.
apiMaterialsHint: The saved local OpenAPI catalog and selection load first. Import a local JSON file or explicitly refresh the network catalog, preview and apply it, then save the checkbox selection to SQLite.
apiMaterialsReasonBodySchema: JSON request body schema is unsupported
apiMaterialsReasonDuplicateParameter: Contains duplicate parameters at one level
apiMaterialsReasonPathParameterMismatch: Path placeholders do not match parameters
apiMaterialsEmpty: The local catalog is empty. Import a local OpenAPI JSON file or explicitly refresh the network catalog.
apiMaterialsFilterNoMatches: No operations match the current filters.
apiMaterialsMissingWarning: {count} selected materials no longer exist in the current OpenAPI. Saving removes their selection but keeps existing Target APIs.
apiMaterialsSaveResult: Selection saved: {created} created, {updated} updated, {unchanged} unchanged, {removed} removed.
apiMaterialsOperationFailed: The API Material operation did not complete. Failed or empty catalogs cannot save removals.
targetApiConfigurationHint: Load Target APIs from selected materials or manually maintain current-Backend relative paths and location-aware parameters. This page saves configuration and sends no request.
targetApiEmpty: No Target API configuration has been saved.
targetApiIdempotencyHelp: Enable this only when repeated delivery of the same business request does not produce duplicate business results. This records a downstream capability and does not add deduplication. Material loading deduplication and target business idempotency are separate concepts.
targetApiSaved: The Target API configuration was saved to local SQLite.
targetApiInUse: This Target API is referenced by a mapping configuration and cannot be deleted.
targetApiOperationFailed: The Target API operation did not complete. Check configuration, revision and references.
targetApiMaterialLoadResult: Material load complete: {created} created, {skipped} skipped, {requiresConfiguration} need parameter completion.
targetApiMaterialDialogHint: Only selected OpenAPI materials saved in the database appear here. Resolved materials bring in their parameters directly; unresolved materials can also be loaded and completed in Target API Configuration. Already loaded entries cannot be selected again.
targetApiMaterialEmpty: No selected API Materials exist. Load OpenAPI and save a selection on the API Materials page first.
targetApiDeleteConfirm: Delete Target API “{name}”? The local service rejects deletion while mappings reference it.
targetApiRemoveSelectedConfirm: Delete the {count} selected Target APIs? The whole deletion is blocked if any selected API is referenced by a mapping configuration.
mappingBatchOperationsHint: Rust validates imports locally and previews changes before explicit application to SQLite. Changed files or revisions require a new preview. Export uses the existing save-file channel.
mappingBatchOperationFailed: The batch operation did not complete. Check file structure, revision and references.
mappingBatchPreviewErrors: The preview contains errors. This batch cannot be applied and no configuration will be written.
mappingValueRulesHint: Maintain reusable finite legal-value presets. Saved facts can be loaded as independent preset drafts; this never reads or updates fact values.
mappingValueRuleRemoveDraftConfirm: Remove the selected {count} local drafts? They have not been saved to SQLite.
mappingValueRuleEmptyValuesHint: An empty array can be saved as a pending preset; it is not selectable from Mapping Configurations.
mappingValueRulesEmpty: No Mapping Value Rule has been saved.
mappingValueRuleSaved: The Mapping Value Rule was saved to local SQLite.
mappingValueRuleInUse: This Mapping Value Rule is referenced by a mapping configuration and cannot be deleted.
mappingValueRuleDeleteConfirm: Delete Mapping Value Rule “{name}”? The local service rejects deletion while mappings reference it.
mappingValueRuleOperationFailed: The value-rule operation did not complete. Check input, revision and references.
mappingConfigurationsHint: Choose a source key and fact for each enabled Target API parameter, or enter a fixed value. Without a value rule, the fact value is used directly; the preview stays local and never sends a target business POST.
mappingConfigurationsEmpty: No mapping configuration has been saved.
mappingConfigurationSaved: The mapping configuration was saved to local SQLite.
mappingConfigurationOperationFailed: The mapping configuration operation did not complete. Check facts, Target API, value rules, and input types.
mappingConfigurationFactMissing: Source unverified / no fact value in this session
mappingConfigurationValueInvalid: Constant does not match the parameter data type
mappingConfigurationRuleRejected: Constant does not match the value rule
mappingConfigurationRuleDeferred: Dynamic fact values are checked at later execution
mappingConfigurationPreviewHint: Draft preview never calls the Target API; saving only writes local SQLite. Saved-row pure preview is read separately from the current Rust revision.
mappingManualRunConfirm: Run saved Mapping “{mappingName}” ({mappingKey}) against Target API “{targetName}” ({targetApiKey}): {method} {path}. This sends a real request and may create or update target business data. Continue?
mappingManualRunInProgress: Manual run is in progress; this saved row is locked
mappingManualRunPreflightRejected: Preflight rejected; no Target request was sent
mappingManualRunSucceeded: This request received a successful response
mappingManualRunFailed: This request received a non-success response
mappingManualRunAmbiguous: Request outcome is ambiguous; no automatic retry occurred
mappingManualRunStale: Configuration changed; this result is stale
apiFirstMappingRuntimeHint: Locks enabled Mapping and Target API configuration at start. Each cycle freshly reads that Mapping’s bound facts and sends a POST, including unchanged values, then waits its saved execution interval. Failed reads do not send old values; reads resume next cycle.
apiFirstMappingRuntimeSafety: A failed Target request or uncertain outcome blocks only the current Mapping, without automatic replay.
mappingRuntimeAutoStartHint: The app-open startup preference is retained. Native admission rejects all automatic delivery in this stage; this is not OS boot startup.
targetApiPartIdentityHint: Part targets require both device and part path bindings. Preserve the OpenAPI names (currently path:device_id and path:part_id, representing deviceId and partId); never infer body.
targetApiPartUnionHint: Card statusValueNN union types cannot currently be imported automatically. Define the target manually with explicit device/part path parameters, a card body template and typed scalar bindings, then inspect the request preview.
sourceFactsMissing: Source contract is missing; no source will be created here.
